subject: Logic
title: Zeno's Paradox
description: A quick, practical guide to Zeno's Paradox.

hook.text: To reach the wall, you must cross half the distance. Then half again. Then half again—infinitely. You never arrive.

buildup.text: Zeno's dichotomy paradox: an infinite number of steps seems to require infinite time. Motion appears impossible.

discovery.text: The resolution: infinite series can sum to finite values. 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/8 + … = 1. Done in finite time.

twist.text: Zeno was wrong about the conclusion but right about the puzzle. It took 2,000 years for calculus to properly resolve it.

climax.text: The paradox teaches that infinity is not automatically impossible—it can be tamed by the right mathematics.

quiz.question: How is Zeno's paradox resolved?
options: Infinite series can converge to finite sums
